p: Enfield Town is the old market town at the heart of the borough, and Southbury Road leads straight into it from the east, with the Palace Gardens shopping centre and the Market Place a couple of minutes' walk away.

There's a historic streak here. Enfield has held a market since the 1300s, and Forty Hall, a Jacobean manor house with its estate and farm, is a short drive north and a lovely free day out. Town Park is right in the centre for a quick breather. Admiral is an adults-only gaming centre, 18+, so leave the kids with someone else. With Enfield Town station on the doorstep, it's easy to get here from Liverpool Street.
